cohort: The study included 84 neonates born to mothers with pre-eclampsia in a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Neonates born to pre-eclamptic mothers have higher risks of prematurity, low birth weight, and neonatal complications such as respiratory distress syndrome, neonatal jaundice, and intrauterine growth restriction.
birth_weight: 58.3% of neonates had low birth weight (<2500g).
gest_age: Mean gestational age was 35.2 +/- 2.4 weeks, with 62% preterm deliveries.
